_note: Video on BirdballSavant. Clips come from TruMedia (AWRE video for NCAA games, matched by TrackMan GameID) and from AWRE clip lists uploaded to data/video/. The site only stores links; the video itself stays on AWRE/TruMedia. Set enabled to false to take every video link off the site.

trumedia._recheck_days: A game with no video yet is asked about again after this many days.

_angle_names: Optional: rename camera columns from TruMedia or AWRE files, e.g. "highHomeUrl": "High home".
